{{Quote|Belongs to Dooku, that lightsaber does.|Yoda|<ref name="DookuCaptured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>}}
A [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved-hilt]] [[Dual-phase lightsaber/Legends|dual-phase]] '''lightsaber''' was constructed by and served [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during his career as both a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], his lightsaber would fall into the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and he used it to kill Dooku with by [[Sai cha/Legends|slicing]] his head off.

==Specifications==
[[File:Dooku_salute.png|thumb|left|250px|Dooku performing a Makashi salute.]]

When Dooku first set about creating this weapon, he chose a configuration that had no connection to either the weapon wielded by his first tutor, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], nor to the style in fashion at the time. Studying Jedi Archive records, Dooku based his new weapon design after the curved hilts that were standard during the heyday of [[Form II/Legends|Form II lightsaber combat]]. The curve allowed the hilt to fit better into his hand, allowing for superior finesse and precise blade control.<ref name="AOTCvd" />

The emitter featured both an angular blade guard and a thumb trigger that activated the weapons dual-phase setting, shortening the blade for a close quarters surprise attack. The first third of the weapon casing was a solid piece that contained an inclined focusing chamber and a series of thermal radiator grooves along the inside of the curve. The crystal chamber was positioned in the joint between this piece and the handgrip. Concealed beneath the fabric covering of the handgrip was a magnetic adhesion plate that secured the weapon to Dooku's belt when not in use. The final third of the hilt contained the activator and the three power cells. The first cell, a compound power cell, was contained in the bend in the hilt directly below the handgrip. The second, a Phase A cell, was positioned next to the activator, a [[Color/Legends|red]] pinky trigger. The last cell, the reserve, was contained in the weapon's pommel.<ref name="AOTCvd" />

==History==
{{Quote|It is obvious that this contest cannot be decided by our knowledge of the Force, but by our skills with a lightsaber.|Dooku|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Dooku_Open_Seasons.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Dooku wields his lightsaber during the Battle of Galidraan.]]
Dooku constructed his lightsaber shortly after becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], deliberately using a design that had little connection to the standard lightsaber he had wielded as a Knight. The Master had entertained a long interest in such designs, including a short, handwritten comment to that effect in his copy of the ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' next to the brief description of a curved-hilt lightsaber.<ref name="JediPath">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Notably, this weapon saw use against the [[True Mandalorians]] during the [[Battle of Galidraan]]. When Dooku left the Jedi Order, he took his lightsaber with him. When he joined the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], Dooku converted the weapon into a [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] by replacing the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|original blue crystal]] with a scarlet synthetic gem, improving the blade's cutting power at the expense of maneuverability. However, despite renouncing the Jedi way, Dooku would continue to greet opponents with the traditional Makashi salute.<ref name="AOTCvd" /><ref name="Open Seasons" /><ref name="SWLightsabers" />

At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dooku would brandish the lightsaber against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Dooku brought down Kenobi with [[Shiim/Legends|light - though damaging - cuts]] across his right arm and leg, while Skywalker's fury forced Dooku to resort to first destroy one of his opponents weapons then [[Cho sun/Legends|amputated]] the young Jedi's arm. Dooku was subsequently confronted by [[Grand Master/Legends|Jedi Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who engaged Dooku in a titanic lightsaber duel. Yoda's might forced Dooku to retreat.<ref name="AOTC" />

[[File:SWTCW5.jpg|thumb|left|224px|Dooku dueled with his lightsaber during the Clone Wars.]]
As the political leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Dooku rarely engaged in battle, and his lightsaber remained largely idle. However, Dooku would on occasion get his hands dirty, and the lightsaber was wielded in several lightsaber duels, some of them rematches with Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="TCWm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref><ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref><ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref><ref name="CrisisonNaboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> He would also engage in sparring matches with the cyborg [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and various members of his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref><ref name="WotM">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref><ref name="J:CD">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref> Most notably, Dooku would wield the lightsaber in a rematch with Yoda on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], even managing to score a hit on his former Jedi mentor, though he was again forced to retreat.<ref name="Y:DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> After crash landing on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], Dooku was provided with transport by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his pirate gang, who quietly stole the lightsaber during the trip before capturing Dooku upon their arrival on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Ohnaka attempted to ransom Dooku to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], displaying the lightsaber as proof of capture. Dooku later managed to escape, though how he retrieved the lightsaber remains unknown.<ref name="DookuCaptured" /><ref name="TheGunganGeneral">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

Towards the conclusion of the war, Dooku wielded the lightsaber in a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|final rematch]] with Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. The basic fighting moves and tactics employed by the Jedi early in the fight lulled Dooku into a false sense of confidence, and left him completely off-guard when they switched to the advanced fighting forms that they had mastered in the interim. Notably, Skywalker's [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] power attacks overwhelmed Dooku's defenses, driving his blade back so far that it scorched his own shoulder. Reevaluating his opponents, Dooku knocked Anakin aside with a well placed kick, and almost effortlessly dispatched Kenobi with a brutal force throw. Sensing Anakin's rage, Dooku attempted to off-balance his foe using [[Dun Möch/Legends|Dun Möch.]] Unfortunately this tactic backfired, and Skywalker lashed out at Dooku in a fury. Dooku was driven back and brutally disarmed by Skywalker, who cut off both of Dooku's hands and seized the lightsaber. Skywalker held both Dooku's lightsaber and [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his own weapon]] in a cross at the Sith Lord's neck, and after continuous goading from [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], decapitated the defeated Count.<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Skywalker abandoned the lightsaber with Dooku's corpse, and it was destroyed soon afterwards when the ''Invisible Hand'' broke in half, and the rear portion containing Dooku's remains burned up in the atmosphere.<ref name="ROTSn" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LordsoftheSith-Dookupointinghilt.png|thumb|right|300px|Count Dooku wielding his lightsaber in a promotional image.]]
When Dooku was originally being conceived for the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], early concept art depicted him as a female Sith. However, as the character was developed, and [[Christopher Lee]] was cast, the concept art was shelved, with the curved hilt of Dooku's lightsaber being the lone holdover from it. The final hilt was designed to resemble a rapier handle, down to the guard, as a reflection in the actor's own skill at fencing.<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
